Have MMA bare knuckle matches against sexy adult Japanese women. It will start stand-up fighting and allow attacks on opponents who are down too.

Your opponent will attack with a variety of punches (elbows included) and kicks (knees included) when standing or ground.

You can freely choose your opponent from a total of four opponents: Shuri, Akiko, Topless Shuri, and Topless Akiko.

Only two topless women, their breasts will be swaying sexily.

Each round is 5 minutes, with a 1 minute timeout, for a total of 3 rounds.

Once the match has started, operations are very simple. Clench your fists lightly (while holding down the trigger on the both controllers) and punch her face or body.

You can also use punches (pounds) on opponents who are lying on the ground.

pc_requirements.minimum:

  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit required)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce GTX1070
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • VR Support: SteamVR - Oculus Quest 2 (Tested to work with Oculus Quest 2)
  • Additional Notes: Room Scale 2m x 2m area required
pc_requirements.recommended:

  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit required) or later
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or better
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce RTX3070 or better
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • VR Support: SteamVR - Oculus Quest 2 or later (Tested to work with Oculus Quest 2)
  • Additional Notes: Room Scale 2m x 2m area or larger
